description: Distinct campaigns responding to a set of search queries for a marketplace over one period, with each campaign's current effective_status, for RR-drop root-cause. Rows are (search_query, os_client_id, merchant_id, campaign_id, campaign_name, effective_status) from os_ads_search_query_performance_report joined to campaign dims (campaign_tagging_data + marketing_campaign_dimensions). A search_query filter is required to scope which queries to inspect; a paused/non-ACTIVE effective_status flags campaigns that stopped responding.

search_query.description: The search term the shopper typed that these campaigns responded to. Required filter: pass the set of queries under investigation.

os_client_id.description: OnlineSales client id of the advertiser responding to the query (working id for internal analysis).

merchant_id.description: Seller (merchant) id whose campaign responded to the query (working id for internal analysis).

campaign_id.description: Marketing campaign id that responded to the search query.

effective_status.description: Current effective status of the campaign (e.g. ACTIVE, PAUSED); a non-ACTIVE status flags a campaign that has stopped responding.

placeholder_metric.description: Constant-zero placeholder so a distinct-dimension (campaign directory) report satisfies the engine's minimum-one-metric requirement; not a real measure.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.os_ads_search_query_performance_report AS resp JOIN reporting.campaign_tagging_data AS ctd ON ctd.campaign_id = resp.campaign_id LEFT JOIN reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions AS mcd ON mcd.marketing_campaign_id = ctd.marketing_campaign_id JOIN reporting.clients AS mc ON resp.marketplace_client_id = mc.client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND resp.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
